defs.def: the details of a person's family, education, experience, etc. 出身背景；学历；经历

ex.s: It blocks out background noise.
ex.t: 它能屏蔽背景噪音。

ex.s: We work with volunteers of all ages and backgrounds.
ex.t: 我们与各种年龄和背景的志愿者合作。

defs.def: the circumstances or past events that help explain why sth is how it is; information about these （事态发展等的）背景

ex.s: Instructors are passionate educators who are experts in their fields and have undergone training and a background check.
ex.t: 指导员是充满热情的教育工作者，是他们领域的专家，并经过了培训和背景调查。

ex.s: The differences between most of the groups were statistically insignificant; however,the participants in the 70 decibels group—those exposed to a level of noise similar to background chatter in a coffee shop-significantly outperformed the other groups.
ex.t: 大多数组之间的差异在统计上不显著；然而，70分贝组的参与者——那些暴露在类似咖啡店背景闲谈噪音水平下的人——明显优于其他组。

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 恰到好处的背景噪音可能恰好会打断我们正常的思维模式，让我们的想象力得以漫游，而不会让人无法集中注意力。

ex.s: Which level of background noise may promote creative thinking ability?
ex.t: 哪个水平的背景噪音可能促进创造性思维能力？

ex.s: To provide the background.
ex.t: 提供背景信息。

ex.s: “Sorry, madam, I have underestimated you as I didn’t know your background. ”
ex.t: “对不起，女士，我低估了您，因为我不知道您的背景。”

ex.s: Add some background information.
ex.t: 补充一些背景信息。

ex.s: •You are able to work with people from different backgrounds.
ex.t: •你能够和不同背景的人一起工作。

ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝下的结果具有显著性，该研究也表明，适当的背景噪音水平——不太吵也不完全无声——实际上可能提升一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: Having these personality traits implies the pre-anger state, where anger is in the background of your mind.
ex.t: 今天太平洋科学中心每年为超过130万人提供服务，并将探究式科学教育带给华盛顿州全州的课堂和社区活动。

ex.s: Background information In the United States, there is an Orientation Day at the beginning of the school year for new students.
ex.t: 在我们的日常生活中，问题会引发更深层次的思考和……/当你被问到……

ex.s: Background information Maya Angelou (1928-2014) was an American poet, writer and civil rights activist.
ex.t: 背景信息 Maya Angelou（1928-2014）是美国诗人、作家和民权活动家。

ex.s: Background information In Britain, the floor of a building at the bottom level is called the "ground floor" and the floor above it is called the "first floor".
ex.t: 背景信息：在英国，大楼最底层的楼面被称为"ground floor"，它上面一层被称为"first floor"。

ex.s: Background information "Not bad" here means "very good".
ex.t: 背景信息：这里的"Not bad"意思是"very good"（很好）。

ex.s: Since the effects were small, this may suggest that our creative thinking does not differ that much in response to total silence and 85 decibels of background noise.
ex.t: 由于影响很小，这可能表明我们的创造性思维在完全安静和85分贝背景噪音下的反应并没有太大不同。

ex.s: The position enabled us to look over the lake with the sunset in the background.
ex.t: 那个位置让我们能以日落为背景俯瞰湖面。

ex.s: Features are written in an individual style, with extra detail and background.
ex.t: 特写文章以个人风格撰写，包含额外的细节和背景信息。

defs.def: the part of a picture, photograph or view behind the main objects, people, etc. 后景；背景
a position in which people are not paying attention to sb/sth or not as much attention as they are paying to sb/sth else 不显眼的位置；幕后
a colour or design on which sth is painted, drawn, etc. 底色；底花；底子
